## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Merchant Hierarchy (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| European Consumer Spending by Merchant | 30-day delayed, All history |
| European Consumer Spending by Merchant Business | 7-day delayed, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ActiveFrom` | String | Date this merchant hierarchy mapping became applicable. A value of 0001-01-01 indicates no known start date. Use with active_to to match against transaction_date from the merchant-aggregates endpoint to perform point-in-time queries. | REST |
| `ActiveTo` | String | Date after which this merchant hierarchy mapping is no longer applicable due to a corporate action. A value of 9999-12-31 indicates the mapping is currently active. | REST |
| `Category` | String | Merchant category assigned by the data provider (Title Case, e.g., 'Groceries', 'General Merchandise', 'Travel'). Values are managed by the data provider and may expand over time. | REST |
| `GrandparentName` | String | Merchant's grandparent business name (Title Case). | REST |
| `GrandparentTicker` | String | Stock ticker of the merchant's grandparent company. Uses Bloomberg standard. | REST |
| `GreatGrandparentName` | String | Merchant's great-grandparent business name (Title Case, top-level corporate entity). | REST |
| `GreatGrandparentTicker` | String | Stock ticker of the merchant's great-grandparent company (top-level corporate entity). Uses Bloomberg standard. | REST |
| `Industry` | String | Industry classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards. | REST |
| `IndustryGroup` | String | Industry group classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards. | REST |
| `ListingStatus` | String | Whether the merchant is a publicly listed company or private. Possible values: public, private. | REST |
| `LookupName` | String | Lowercase merchant tag used for joining with the merchant-aggregates endpoint name field (e.g., 'asda', 'amazon'). | REST |
| `NormalizedName` | String | Cleaned, standardized merchant display name (Title Case, e.g., 'Asda', 'Amazon'). | REST |
| `ParentName` | String | Merchant's parent business name (Title Case). Useful for aggregating transactions across subsidiary brands. | REST |
| `ParentTicker` | String | Stock ticker of the merchant's parent company. Uses Bloomberg standard. | REST |
| `Sector` | String | Sector classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards. | REST |
| `SubIndustry` | String | Sub-industry classification based on GICS/BICS/ICB standards. | REST |
| `Ticker` | String | Stock ticker associated with the merchant (~250 US public companies mapped). Uses Bloomberg standard. | REST |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST |
